paper_title: What Does Neuro Mean to Cardio Investigating the Role of Clinical   Specialty Data in Medical LLMs
caption: Negative log-probabilities for clinically relevant tokens between baseline Mistral-v0.2 and the same model further fine-tuned on each specialty data. Each group represents tokens categorized into different clinical specialties. Each color means that the same model is further fine-tuned on each specialty data.

model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the negative log-probabilities for clinically relevant tokens between the baseline Mistral-v0.2 model and the same model fine-tuned on different specialty data. The horizontal axis represents per-specialty terms, labeled as Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, and is categorical. The vertical axis is labeled "Negative log probability" and has a linear scale, ranging from -27 to -22 with a tick label interval of 1. Each category on the horizontal axis is represented by a grouped set of bars, with each group containing six bars of different colors, corresponding to the model fine-tuned on different specialty data, as indicated by the legend: Mistralv0.2-Base (blue) and fine-tuned on Cardio (light orange), Gastro (dark orange), Infect (orange-brown), Neuro (brown), Obstetrics (dark brown), and Pediatrics (black-brown). The bars within each group are arranged in the same order as the legend, and their heights vary, with the blue bar (Mistralv0.2-Base) being the tallest in most categories, with values around -26 for Cardio and -24.5 for others, while the fine-tuned models have shorter bars, with values ranging from approximately -23.5 to -22.5. The bars are not sorted in a specific order within each group, and no bars are visually emphasized.
model_annotations.German: The chart illustrates the negative log-probabilities of clinically relevant tokens for different medical specialties using the Mistral-v0.2 model and its fine-tuned versions. The horizontal axis represents the per-specialty terms, labeled as Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, while the vertical axis is labeled "Negative log probability" with a linear scale ranging from -27 to -22. The chart features grouped bars, where each group corresponds to a medical specialty and contains six bars representing the baseline Mistral-v0.2 model and its fine-tuned versions on different specialty data, distinguished by colors: light blue for the baseline, and shades of orange and brown for the fine-tuned models, specifically Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The bars within each group are arranged in the same order as the legend, and their heights vary, with the shortest bar in the Cardio group reaching approximately -26.5 and the tallest bars across groups being around -22.5. The chart does not display any specific sorting order for the bars within or across groups, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond the color coding provided by the legend.
